## Specific task description

Task instruction: Put the smooth metal bell to the right of the smooth soap.

Task description: Move the silver metal bell with a black base and place it on the tabletop near the right side of the light-yellow bar of soap. “Right” here refers to the tabletop’s left-right direction in the head-camera view.

Success criteria: Place the bell to the right of the soap, approximately aligned front to back, with a small gap on the table, neither too close nor too far apart. Both grippers must be open and release the objects. Remaining front-right of the soap with a substantial longitudinal offset does not count.

## Execution tips

- Prefer grasping exposed opposite sides of the black base, with the pads against a wider part of the side wall. Avoid the smooth rounded top and button to reduce slipping.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp section. Before closing, confirm that both fingers actually enclose the base and that the fingertips are not against the table, rather than relying on image overlap alone.
- Use the tabletop grid to check the bell’s front-back relationship to the soap, leaving clearance between the bell, fingers, soap, and pump bottle behind them to avoid contact while correcting its position.
- Release only after the black base rests flat on the table. During withdrawal, check whether the fingertips still touch the base, avoiding dragging or tipping the bell.
